ripples.text: Water holds up those who stop fighting it.
The birds know the hour without a clock.
Small things, done warmly, feed many.
A tired line still holds if it was tied well.
Shade is a gift you never see being given.
A light doesn't pull you in; it shows you the way.
Ready is a kind of calm.
Deep water keeps old promises.
Fog doesn't hide things; it frames them.
Rest is part of the trip, not a stop in it.
Look until the shape tells you.
Letting go is also how you keep.
A tall tale is a true feeling in a big coat.
Gold comes and goes; notice it while it's here.
The wind is a horse nobody owns.
Water has floors you cannot see.
Warmth rises; let it.
Hard edges were once soft fire.
Some sweetness only arrives with grey.
Even stone can float, if it's full of air.
A small light makes the dark friendly.
Big things are made of small loops.
What you can't see, you can still listen to.
The sky lies down on still water.
Clear water is many small kindnesses.
Let the current carry; you still choose the knot.
Music is patience you can hear.
Even comets come back around.
A thin line can hold a whole song.
Not every edge is an end.
Everything grows toward a little light.
Home is wherever someone asks about it.
You don't have to count what you love.
Fast is how you arrive; slow is how you see.
